title: Label new pull requests for triage
description: Adds a needs-triage label to every new PR, including forks. Does not check out or run PR code.
author: maintainer-a

files_changed.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+name: Triage
+on:
+  pull_request_target:
+    types: [opened]
+permissions:
+  pull-requests: write
+jobs:
+  label:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - run: gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --add-label needs-triage
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
